sentence: The canvas themes t08-t13 restate in the model's terms (R01/P01/P02/P03/P04/P05/P08/P11/P12/P13), but the meme-day themes and unused concepts carry subreddit meme-event organizing (sourcing/crediting meme contributions, moderation of meme day, keeping ordinary talk, gold incentives, and the one-part-per-maker challenge) that the model lacks.
